ONNX Runtime Android 1.24.1
Official artifact: com.microsoft.onnxruntime:onnxruntime-android:1.24.1
Source release: https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/tree/v1.24.1
Source license: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/v1.24.1/LICENSE
Third-party notices: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/v1.24.1/ThirdPartyNotices.txt
The complete official MIT license and upstream dependency notices are retained.
This SDK selects CPU execution only. CUDA, TensorRT, NNAPI, cloud and training
execution are not enabled. Native binary provenance and page alignment must be
checked against the exact final APK before release.
